spec_acceptance_criteria.description: CronSchedulerJob replaces CronSchedulerService (Automation, queue=automation, cron minutely — tick model: job reads DB schedule_trigger flows, fires those due)
Old service classes deleted (no external callers; IsPositiveResponse was dead code)

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: CronScheduler uses Tick model (A from interview): Hangfire minutely recurring fires CronSchedulerJob.RunAsync which reads DB schedule_trigger flows and evaluates each Cronos expression against lastFired+now window
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Preserves byte-identical behavior with current 60s timer. Dynamic per-tenant Hangfire recurring (option B) would require CRUD hooks for every flow save and orphan cleanup. Tick model keeps logic in one place.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: CronSchedulerJob owns ConcurrentDictionary<int, DateTimeOffset> _lastFired as a Singleton state — therefore the job class is registered AddSingleton, not AddScoped. Hangfire resolves singleton handlers fine.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: RescueFollowUpJob runs cron '0 */4 * * *' (every 4 hours at minute 0)
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Matches prior TimeSpan.FromHours(4) ticker. Initial 5-minute delay at service boot is N/A in Hangfire — first run happens at next cron boundary, acceptable drift.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: No initial delay primitive in Hangfire recurring — use cron alone.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Both old service classes deleted entirely (not [Obsolete])
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: PP-006. No external callers: grep confirmed CronSchedulerService/RescueFollowUpService referenced only in Program.cs DI wiring + one dead-code comment in Program.cs line 1870. IsPositiveResponse static method never called.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: Files deleted. Comment in Program.cs:1870 updated to reference CronSchedulerJob.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Both jobs carry NO tenant_id arg — they are service-wide iterators (same pattern as Faz 1 FlowWaitResumer)
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Both pull due candidates across all tenants from repository/marketing client, then per-item processing is tenant-scoped.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: CQ7 tenant-isolation N/A for top-level job signature. Per-item calls use risk.TenantId / flow.TenantId.

RescueFollowUpJob is stateless (no instance fields beyond DI) — Scoped registration OK?
Business logic (Cronos parsing, timezone, _lastFired write-before-execute, schedule counter, session create/end) byte-identical to deleted CronSchedulerService?
Top-level exception swallow removed in both jobs — failures bubble to Hangfire (AutomaticRetry + INV-JOB-005)?
IsPositiveResponse confirmed dead code (grep shows no callers) — safe to drop with service class?

Removing Cronos NuGet (still needed for cron expression parsing inside tick)

No appsettings changes (cron strings defaulted in Program.cs; overridable via Cron:* config keys)
